philosophy.body: We believe good dentistry starts before any instrument touches a tooth — with a clear diagnosis and a plan you actually understand.

safetyItems: Single-use consumables wherever the procedure calls for it
Sterile packaging and shelf-life checks on every instrument
A sterilization log kept for every cycle
Treatment room prepared fresh before every patient

generalFaq.a: Yes — some of our doctors see children; mention the child's age when booking and we'll match you with the right specialist.

generalFaq.q: Is instalment payment available for costly treatment
generalFaq.a: For longer treatments (implants, orthodontics) staged payment can be arranged — details are discussed at the consultation.

generalFaq.q: What contraindications should I know about
generalFaq.a: Contraindications are individual and depend on overall health — your doctor will review them at your visit before finalizing a plan.

generalFaq.q: Should I bring existing X-rays or records
generalFaq.a: Yes — any previous imaging or medical history helps us plan more precisely from your very first visit.
